==Description==
The '''SUPER MEGA LEAD BALLOON''', internally referred to as just '''Lead Balloon''' is a joke enemy that can only be spawned by the game's developers. It also appears in the [[Index]]. It has extremely high health, extremely slow speed and only one [[Shield Health]]. It is the modern version of the [[Lead Balloon]]

==Appearance==
The '''SUPER MEGA LEAD BALLOON''' is a faceless humanoid with reflective dark green skin, and a reflective dark grey torso and legs. It has three lead balloons tied to its back, which, after taking enough damage, pop into yellow particles and drops it lower to the ground. When it loses all shield health, all the balloons would have popped and the '''SUPER MEGA LEAD BALLOON''' would become grounded, removing its flying attribute and making it walk along the path.
